text:
Priya Raman: Quick flag: we're getting inconsistent client-facing messages when requests hit fallback routes. Console shows 'Degraded' for some tenants and plain 500s for others. Need a single error/failure shape + telemetry to keep badge state meaningful.

Luca Moretti: Agree. We should define a small, explicit schema instead of free-form error text. Suggest fields: client_status (OK/RETRYABLE/THROTTLED/FAILED), route_origin (string), reason_code (RATE_LIMIT|TIMEOUT|MODEL_OOM|INTERNAL), and optional retry_after_ms. Keep visible_message_key for i18n.

Aaron Chu: One extra: add visibility_level (public/internal) so we can control whether a visible_message shows in SDKs or only in the console. That avoids leaking infra hints to clients.

Priya Raman: Good point. For fallbacks, prefer to encode them as OK + route_origin=small-model OR RETRYABLE with reason_code=MODEL_OOM depending on outcome. That way the SDK doesn't need to infer from HTTP status.

Luca Moretti: Example payload (compact):

```json
{"error":{"client_status":"THROTTLED","reason_code":"RATE_LIMIT","retry_after_ms":90000,"route_origin":"us-east-1/fallback-small","visible_message_key":"quota.tenant.exceeded"}}
```

Aaron Chu: SDK mapping rules proposal: map client_status -> typed error classes. If visibility_level=public, SDK surfaces visible_message (or resolves visible_message_key via locale bundle). If missing client_status, fall back to legacy mapping: 429->THROTTLED, 5xx->FAILED.

Priya Raman: Telemetry needs: add tags event.client_status, event.route_origin, event.reason_code, event.tenant_bucket. Console will use those for badge state, incident grouping, and rollout delta dashboards. Also include a sampled raw_error_tag for early rollout to debug.

Luca Moretti: For rollout: feature-flag per-tenant; start with opt-in at 5% sampled traffic, collect errors + badge diff for 72 hours, then 25% for another 72h. Rollback if any spike in user-facing FAILED or a >5% increase in SDK surfaced ThrottleErrors.

deploy-bot: Feature flag gated rollout created: client-failure-shape-v1. Canary enabled for eng-platform at 2024-02-15T14:10Z.

Aaron Chu: Migration checklist: server returns new shape behind flag; SDK update (minor) to parse client_status and visible_message_key; console update to use telemetry tags and vendor i18n keys; docs + changelog. Make server default to legacy behavior when client_status absent.

Priya Raman: UI asks: we need a mapping table for console badge logic (e.g., THROTTLED or RETRYABLE -> yellow/degraded; FAILED -> red). Add runbook links for each mapping.

Luca Moretti: I'll add that to the RFC. Also recommend we avoid putting route_origin as high-cardinality in primary metrics; use it as a facet for traces and logs, aggregated in dashboards.

Aaron Chu: I'll own the SDK PR and the feature-flag gating. Priya, can you own the RFC and the runbook snippets?

Priya Raman: Yep. I'll draft RFC by EOD tomorrow with examples, telemetry names, and console badge mapping. Will include sample locale keys for copy.

Luca Moretti: Thanks. When RFC is up, tag me and I'll wire the dashboards and devops alerts.

Priya Raman: Filed RFC path: rfc/1720054321-client-failure-shape.md 1
